title: Same Spectrum, Harder First-Order Training: Phase-Locking in Single- versus Multi-Qubit Re-Uploading Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2610.21778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Angle-encoded variational quantum circuits implement truncated Fourier series. For one-dimensional inputs, a single-qubit re-uploading (serial) circuit represents every function that a multi-qubit circuit with the same encoding budget $E$ can; we find that this exchange of width for depth is not free in first-order training. Because its state lives on the Bloch sphere, all parameters of the serial circuit move the state, at each input, along one complex direction, which we call \emph{phase-locking}. We prove that this costs no Fourier direction but leaves no direction to spare: however many parameters it has, the serial circuit has at most $2E+2$ tangent directions, one more than its $2E+1$ Fourier coefficients need, while a two-qubit control with the same encoding budget and model class generically has at least $6E+6$. translated_title: 相同频谱，更难的一阶训练：单比特与多比特重复上传电路中的相位锁定
translated_abstract: 角度编码的变分量子电路实现的是截断傅里叶级数。对于一维输入，单比特重复上传（串行）电路能够表示具有相同编码预算 $E$ 的多比特电路所能表示的所有函数；我们发现在一阶训练中，这种“以宽度换深度”的交换并非没有代价。由于串行电路的状态生活在布洛赫球上，其所有参数在每个输入点只能沿一个复数方向移动状态，我们将这一现象称为“相位锁定”（phase-locking）。我们证明这不会损失任何傅里叶方向，但也没有富余的方向：无论参数有多少，串行电路至多只有 $2E+2$ 个切方向，仅比其 $2E+1$ 个傅里叶系数所需的多一个，而具有相同编码预算和模型类的双比特对照电路通常至少拥有 $6E+6$ 个切方向。训练代价正是相对于该对照来衡量的，即在100次运行中在给定预算内达到最优值的次数……
tldr: 单比特重复上传电路虽与多比特电路在相同编码预算下具有同等的傅里叶表达能力，但因布洛赫球约束产生的“相位锁定”使其切方向至多只有 $2E+2$ 个（远少于双比特对照电路的 $6E+6$ 个），导致一阶训练明显更困难。
en_tdlr: A single-qubit re-uploading circuit matches the expressive power of a multi-qubit circuit with the same encoding budget, but its Bloch-sphere constraint causes "phase-locking" with at most $2E+2$ tangent directions (versus at least $6E+6$ for a two-qubit control), making first-order training significantly harder.
